description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between model size (on a logarithmic scale) and three performance metrics—Precision, Recall, and F1-score—expressed as average performance percentages. The x-axis, labeled “Model Size (log scale),” spans from 70m to 7.0B parameters, with tick marks at 70m, 160m, 410m, 1.0B, 1.4B, 2.8B, and 7.0B; the logarithmic spacing reflects exponential growth in model size. The y-axis, labeled “Avg. Performance (%)”, ranges from 0 to 80 in increments of 20. Three distinct lines are plotted: Precision (red line with triangle markers) starts near 78% at 70m and gradually declines to approximately 75% at 7.0B; Recall (blue line with triangle markers) begins around 8% at 70m and steadily increases to about 45% at 7.0B; F1-score (purple line with triangle markers) rises from roughly 15% at 70m to approximately 57% at 7.0B. All three lines show a consistent upward or downward trend across the model size range, with no sharp fluctuations, indicating a smooth scaling behavior of performance metrics with increasing model capacity.
